99:        mkdir -p /etc/postgresql-common &&
100:        cat > /etc/postgresql-common/pg_service.conf <<EOF
101:      [${QGIS_PG_SERVICE_NAME:-qonnectra}]
102:      host=db
103:      port=5432
104:      dbname=${DB_NAME}
105:      user=${QGIS_DB_USER}
106:      password=${QGIS_DB_PASSWORD}

108:      EOF
109:        mkdir -p /var/www/data/qgis &&
110:        ln -sf /usr/lib/cgi-bin/qgis_mapserv.fcgi /var/www/data/qgis/qgis_mapserv.fcgi &&
111:        rm -f /tmp/.X99-lock &&
112:        fc-cache &&
113:        /usr/bin/Xvfb :99 -ac -screen 0 1280x1024x16 +extension GLX +render -noreset >/dev/null &
114:        sleep 2 &&
115:        grep -q 'client_max_body_size' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf || sed -i '/http {/a \    client_max_body_size 500M;' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf &&
116:        nginx &&
117:        spawn-fcgi -F 2 -u www-data -g www-data -d /var/lib/qgis -P /run/qgis.pid -p 9993 -- /usr/lib/cgi-bin/qgis_mapserv.fcgi &&
118:        tail -f /dev/null
119:      "

122:    volumes:
